name: hxn
description: The Haxe classes of libraries built with hxn: futures, streams, signals, reactive values, atomics, and the macro that binds a packaged library.
releasenote: Under Emscripten, futures settled by a JavaScript callback are delivered from the page's event loop, and Haxe events queued after main returns run; hxn run and check take --browser for a cpp --wasm program; link-args passes linker arguments by target triple.
